label: Phones side by side
description: Two to four phones side by side, each showing a picture or a clip, one landing per spoken word: things running at the same time (agents working in parallel, apps compared). A phone demo may cover the face; it stays above the captions.

items.help: 2 to 4 screens (pictures or clips), left to right

focusY.help: which part of a tall screenshot shows: 0 = top
